name: evb-viewer
author: Eugene Barsky <34789976+evb0110@users.noreply.github.com>
description: EVB Viewer — a PDF and DjVu document viewer

scripts.dev: pnpm electron:run stop --session=default && nuxt prepare && pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:clean: pnpm run clean:cache && nuxt prepare && pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:quick: pnpm run build:electron && tsx scripts/electron-run.ts start
scripts.dev:fast: pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k "nuxt dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3235 && electron ."
scripts.build:log: mkdir -p .tmp && bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; pnpm run build 2>&1 | tee .tmp/build.log'
scripts.build:strict: pnpm run build:log && pnpm run build:warnings:check
scripts.build:electron: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/main.js --external:electron --external:electron-updater && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/image/pdf-combine-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/pdf-combine-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/ocr/worker/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/ocr-worker.js --external:electron && esbuild electron/search/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/search-worker.js --external:electron && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs dist-electron/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:electron && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss}" && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix --max-warnings=0 && stylelint "app/**/*.{vue,scss}" && pnpm run check:locales && pnpm run check:icons:bundle
scripts.gate:quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:coverage
scripts.validate: pnpm run gate:quality && pnpm run build:strict && pnpm run knip && pnpm run check:architecture
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e:electron:smoke
scripts.test:e2e:electron: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --config vitest.electron-e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:electron:smoke: pnpm run build:electron && vitest run --config vitest.electron-e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/electron/phase1.annotation-lifecycle.e2e.test.ts tests/e2e/electron/phase3.annotation-history-persistence.e2e.test.ts tests/e2e/electron/phase4.marker-drag-persistence.e2e.test.ts
scripts.release:patch: HUSKY=0 pnpm run release:verify && pnpm version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: HUSKY=0 pnpm run release:verify && pnpm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: HUSKY=0 pnpm run release:verify && pnpm version major && git push && git push --tags
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm run check:architecture:dep-graph && pnpm run check:architecture:boundaries
scripts.gate:pre-release: pnpm run validate && pnpm run test:full
